title: Strun Prime
extract:
Strun Prime is the Primed variant of the  Strun. In addition to being a direct upgrade, it has gained innate punch through and longer damage falloff range, but at the expense of slower reload speed. It was released alongside  Nidus Prime and  Magnus Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact and  Slash damage.
Reloads one shell at a time at a rate of 0.4 seconds per shell, which can be interrupted at any point, allowing for planned reloading.
Reloading has a total 0.6 second delay to start and end.
Individual shell reload causes magazine increasing effects to increase total reload time.
Advantages over other Primary  Shotgun weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Innate 0.8 meter punch through.
The linear damage falloff is further away than most shotguns: from 100% to 50% from 26m to 52m target distance (distances are affected by Projectile Speed).

Acquisition

Notes

Incarnon Genesis

Upon completion of The Duviri Paradox and Angels of the Zariman, and unlocking The Steel Path, players can earn  Strun Incarnon Genesis from The Circuit's Steel Path to place on their Strun with the help of Cavalero in the Chrysalith. This Incarnon Genesis form grants it evolutions to a transformation and newfound strength.
Purchased from Cavalero for  120, complete with the resources used in its installation. This purchase can only be made once.

Installing the Strun Incarnon Genesis requires 20  Pathos Clamps, 60  Rune Marrow, and 60  Tasoma Extract.
When installed, the first Evolution tier is unlocked. Each challenge additionally grants 5,000 affinity to the weapon, affected by Affinity Boosters.

Overview
Incarnon Form is charged by filling the Incarnon Transmutation gauge that appears under the reticle by achieving weakpoint hits and then pressing the Alternate Fire button. 40 weakpoints hits will completely fill the gauge. A full gauge is not required to activate Incarnon Form.
Charges do not generate on the backpacks of most MOA variants, or vulnerability spots generated by  Sonar or  Detect Vulnerability in places other than actual weakpoints.
Weakpoints on corpses or Invulnerable targets do not build charges.
Individual Multishot bullets can build charges.
Mode switching is not instantaneous and has an animation equal to the weapon's reload speed.
Swapping to and from Incarnon Form will fully reload the normal form's magazine.
Instead of drawing ammunition from its reserves, the Strun's Incarnon Form uses a separate "magazine" with each charge producing 1 rounds to a maximum of 40. Once all ammunition is expended, the Strun reverts to its normal form.
Incarnon Form's magazine is not affected by mods.
Incarnon Form is not affected by Ammo Efficiency (such as  Energized Munitions).
Charges and Incarnon Form persists through all activities, such as holstering, bleedout, or being disarmed. However, charges and Incarnon Form are removed upon death.

Evolutions

Tips
Because of the need to reload the magazine one shot at a time, the Strun Prime has an extremely slow reload speed before reaching maximum ammo capacity. It can therefore benefit from things that help economize its loaded ammo such as  Energized Munitions, or those that bypass its reloading mechanism such as from  Garuda's  Bloodletting with the  Blood Forge augment, to maintain the weapon's otherwise generally high overall DPS output potential.
